title: Surreal Eye of Imagination
description: A young man in ornate blue and gold historical attire kneels on a grassy shore beside a wooden boat, extending his hand toward a vibrant rainbow-colored stream of objects flowing from a giant central eye. The eye contains a pastoral landscape with horses, a pink polka-dot bowl of colorful liquid, and is surrounded by orbiting planets, a large water droplet, and floating geometric shapes against a dramatic sunset sky.
prompt: A surreal visionary scene featuring a young man in ornate baroque blue and gold coat kneeling on a grassy riverbank next to a wooden sailboat, reaching toward a swirling rainbow stream of objects emerging from a massive central human eye. Inside the eye is a green pastoral landscape with horses and a large pink polka-dot bowl overflowing with colorful liquid. The eye is surrounded by orbiting planets, a giant water droplet, floating mathematical symbols and geometric shapes against a dramatic fiery orange and purple sunset sky with stars. Three men in black suits stand in the stream, sailboats on the water, colorful houses on the distant shore.
